sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3822 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.258/2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Chirala I town police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 273, 120-b r/w.34 IPC and Sections 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Chirala I town police Station, Prakasam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent -State.
At the time of hearing, both the counsel gave consent to dispose of the matter at the stage of admission.
Learned counsel for petitioners submits that the subject matter of the criminal petition is squarely covered by the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not refute the said submission.

Considering the submissions and having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, the proceedings in FIR No.258/2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Chirala I town police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioners, are hereby quashed in terms of the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.

entities.text: Chirala I town police Station, Prakasam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: With the above observations, the criminal petition is allowed at the stage of admission.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH 11th September, 2020 Mjl/*
